guard: A manager starts startup static lifecycle reconciliation, then overlaps the remaining sweep with control-service registration; every alias in the collected reconcile plan is refused for spawn until its own terminal attempt returns.
why: The live fixture creates real durable ACTIVE orphan rows against a real JWT broker before the
manager starts. It waits for an observed terminal transition, then calls the registered status
service while later rows are still ACTIVE. This is the entrypoint and outage shape, not a
The second cell invokes spawn for a later planned alias. It must reach the manager service and
be refused by the alias fence before lifecycle provisioning. That catches both moving the fence
behind an await and dropping the startAgent guard.
Batch B2 (2026-09-03): the seat's turn relay had the same boot window as spawn-as-action, and
an empty answer is worse than a refusal: the seat reads `{turns: []}` as `you hold nothing` and
a not-found yield as `drop it`, while a refusal means `keep what you hold`.

mutations.name: a late yield after the deadline committed hears not-found instead of the deny
mutations.expectRed: a yield after the deny committed, before the index drop, is told the turn ended failed, never `not-found`
mutations.cell: a yield after the deny committed, before the index drop, is told the turn ended failed, never `not-found`
mutations.note: #1262. After commitTurnDeadline deletes pending (the latch, before the terminal CAS) the only in-memory answer a late yield could find was turnAcceptances.settled. When that field was not yet written, or a concurrent sweep dropped it, the yield heard not-found for a deny the run already has. The durable terminal is the answer; the index drop is not the cause (the yield path never consults it).

mutations.note: #1694 half 1, the binding test. The cell's non-holder DISHONESTLY claims holdsDeliveryLease:true (the issue's actual attack: a responder that does not hold the lease can assert that it does), so the claim check passes and only the row-holder comparison can refuse. Dropping the comparison lets the pass read shared off the non-holder's matching store and take the renewal lease.
